language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot closes its gripper around the wooden spoon at frames 57–64 in wrist_image, then lifts and transports it toward the open drawer at frames 70–110 in image and left_ego_image. At frames 138–141 in wrist_image, the gripper releases the spoon into the drawer; frames 142–150 show it resting inside as the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, unintended object disturbance, or other side effect is visible.
